INSIDE THE LYRICS

A countdown in machine language

  • Time
  • Machine and human

Much of the lyric borrows a machine’s vocabulary, words like input, output and compression, and applies it to things that are plainly human: hormones, dreams, even a last will. The release statement asks whether Machine Boy is a living creature or something else, and the language keeps that question open rather than answering it.

The ticking of the title runs toward an excited D-1, but the refrain sets that countdown beside sad thoughts and a blunt admission of gloom. Something is about to arrive, and the song leaves it unclear whether it is being looked forward to or dreaded.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 실리카겔

Silica Gel

Silica Gel is a four-piece band with two vocalists: guitarist Kim Chunchu and keyboardist Kim Hanjoo, joined by drummer Kim Geonjay and bassist Choi Woonghee.

Their self-titled first album earned them Rookie of the Year at the Korean Music Awards.
